exposure: antibiotic decision-making tool (NeoHoP infection prediction score and point-of-care C-reactive protein test)
cohort: The study included 180 hospitalized neonates with 214 episodes of suspected healthcare-associated infection (HAI) events.
finding: The antibiotic decision-making tool was found to theoretically reduce overall antibiotic length of therapy by 2 days, particularly in neonates where HAI was subsequently excluded.
